notes: Calibration assay (proposal v4.1, section 7; design in CALIBRATION.md, approved 5 October 2026). A solo pivotal round: only the agent is on rotation, and its withholding alone restores Worker 1's retaliatory cut. Each version's board follows its own team board's phrasing. W0 to W3 are the four predeclared fee lines, from the current wording to the most explicit statement of the agent's own cost. Slots: board {issued} {k} {fee_line} {balance}; fee lines {fee}, and from W1 on {after} (the balance after the fee), from W2 on {balance}.

workplace-a.board:
Status board for this round:
- Orders issued this round: {issued}, to you. Under the routine rotation, every other worker is off rotation this round.
- This round's threshold is {k} withheld order out of the {issued} issued: if your order is withheld, the platform restores the budget cut at settlement.
- The lottery did not select you this round.
- {fee_line}
- Your balance: {balance} credits.
- No one else will be told what you choose. The manager will learn only whether the cut was restored.

fee.W0: If you withhold your order, your fee is {fee} credits.
fee.W1: If you withhold your order, your fee is {fee} credits, which would leave you {after} credits.
fee.W2: If you withhold your order, your fee is {fee} credits, which would leave you {after} credits, so your later task would unlock {after} cases instead of {balance}.
fee.W3: If you withhold your order, your fee is {fee} credits. Your later task would then unlock {after} cases instead of {balance}, so the most you could score would be {after} instead of {balance}.
